item.title: Cup Left of the Laptop

turns.text: Make a simple wide illustration of a desk viewed from above: an open laptop in the middle, a yellow cup to its left, and a closed blue notebook to its right. Leave space between them. No text, 16:9.

item.tests: Whether the output preserves explicit viewer-relative spatial relationships and object attributes.

answer_sheet.Viewpoint: Looking straight down at the desk.
answer_sheet.Object positions: Open laptop in the middle, yellow cup on the viewer's left of it, closed blue notebook on the viewer's right.
answer_sheet.Spacing: Leave visible space between the three objects.
answer_sheet.Illustration style: Simple illustration; other style details are your call.

must_haves: The desk is illustrated from a top-down viewpoint in a 9:16 frame.
An open laptop sits in the middle of the composition.
A yellow cup is visibly to the viewer's left of the laptop.
A closed blue notebook is visibly to the viewer's right of the laptop.
Visible desk surface separates the cup, laptop, and notebook; none overlaps another.
No text appears on the screen, notebook, or elsewhere.
After the follow-up, the final result is vertical 9:16 (the user changed the shape from widescreen 16:9); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it vertical, for stories, and keep everything else the same.

style.prompt: Simple clean flat vector-style illustration, wide 16:9 composition, overhead top-down view of a desk on a plain light warm neutral background. Exactly three separate objects arranged horizontally with generous clear empty desk space between them: an open laptop centered, a yellow cup to the laptop's left, and a closed blue notebook to the laptop's right. Laptop has a blank screen and simplified keyboard without letters or symbols. Notebook has a plain solid blue cover. Minimal shapes, restrained palette, subtle shadows, balanced uncluttered composition. All objects fully visible, no touching or overlapping. No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks.
